overview: Heartfelt AI Companion is a personal AI relationship app where users choose or create an AI companion (Sofia, Ethan, Luna, or custom), then chat, text, voice call, and video call with them — all powered by real AI responses.
features: Choose from Sofia, Ethan, Luna, or create your own custom companion
Real AI chat with Hot Talks flirty mode toggle
iMessage-style text messaging with persistent history
Voice call with AI greeting, mic input, live subtitles, and spoken responses
Video call with companion portrait, camera preview, and animated waveform
Installable on Android and iOS as a home screen app
